description: Speckle Server is the server, viewer and supporting web code for exchanging architecture, engineering and construction models. It stores project objects and versions and connects them to client tools for collaborative workflows. Users send model geometry and properties through compatible connectors; the server exposes the shared objects and change history for a chosen project. Geographic coverage depends on the assets represented by those objects. The provider README describes self-hosting and development, while the repository licence file states Apache-2.0 for the open portions and separate Speckle Enterprise Edition terms for named server modules. This mixed licence must be checked before deployment or modification of those modules. A limitation is that sharing model objects is not, by itself, a physical simulation or proof that data from two design tools preserve the same meaning. Speckle can supply versioned building inputs to a digital-twin workflow. The related catalogue IfcOpenShell record is an IFC parser, not this server. No server or model data was installed.
